p4_b0.ocr: Inference of competing endogenous RNA interaction networks

p4_b1.ocr: Fig 3. Hazard ratio distribution of prognostic ceRNAs and non-ceRNAs in each cancer type. A prognostic RNA was defined as a DE RNA whose p- value from the univariate Cox regression was smaller than 0.05. For each cancer type, the prognostic RNAs were categorized into ceRNAs and non- ceRNAs. The p-values shown in the plot were from the Wilcoxon rank-sum test between hazard ratios of prognostic ceRNAs and non-ceRNAs. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pcbi.1006318.g003
